subject: [PATCH v3 07/18] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for address ranges

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called is_range_backed_by_folio_orders to the selftests/mm module. The function checks if an address range can be collapsed into folios of a specific order, by verifying that each order-aligned window of the range maps exactly one folio of that order, with its head PFN at the natural alignment and a contiguous PFN run across the window. This is useful for testing mTHP collapse scenarios where the range needs to be checked if it can be collapsed into folios of a particular order.
